objective: independent actual-graph regression of the rooted tight-code / Hall / pair-capacity interface

generated_corpus.method: random-order edge minimization from K_n, with final D2C re-verification

matched_candidate_n10.purpose: matched_first policy exercises a genuine matched-B A-edge criticality certificate

coverage_gap: No actual rigid complete Hall cut with x>=3 was found in the bounded realizable corpus, so the rigid singleton-head block is implemented but not dynamically exercised by a positive graph fixture. The one-code purification remains a hand theorem built from independently regressed upstream ingredients, not an observed small-graph configuration.
trust_boundary: Actual-graph regression is evidence against graph-to-constraint transcription errors, not a proof of universal premises or graph realizability of abstract survivor states.
